subject: MSA + Order Form: Exhibit ownership, signatory mapping, and evidence request
messages:
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Brooks <erin@finlogix.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + Order Form: Exhibit ownership, signatory mapping, and evidence request

Hi Erin —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I’m starting the formal intake so Legal and Contracts can begin review. Two quick asks to help us scope the redline pass and identify the right signatory path:

1) Exhibit ownership: the Order Form references Exhibit A for data residency and billing tiers. Can you confirm whether Exhibit A will be provided by FinLogix or should we start from the template attached? If FinLogix is providing, please share the latest Exhibit A export.

2) Signatory mapping: who at FinLogix signs on behalf of the parent entity vs. the individual product entity? We need the signatory names/titles and whether they require countersignature via DocuSign or manual signature.

3) Security evidence: FinLogix requested SOC2 / penetration test evidence during procurement. If you have a landing link or a PDF snapshot we can attach to the intake ticket, please share.

I’ve attached Redwood’s MSA template (for reference) and a blank Exhibit A CSV that shows the fields we map to billing/accounting. If you can send the FinLogix Exhibit and confirm the signers by EOD Wednesday, we’ll queue a contracts review and aim to return a marked-up MSA + order form in 3 business days.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_template_v3.pdf (attachment), ExhibitA_template.csv (attachment)

From: Erin Brooks <erin@finlogix.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinLogix Legal <legal@finlogix.com>, Procurement Team <procurements@finlogix.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: Exhibit ownership, signatory mapping, and evidence request

Hi Karthik —

Thanks — attaching the current FinLogix Exhibit A export and our standard signature matrix. A couple notes:

- Exhibit A: attached as FinLogix_ExhibitA_20270614.csv — this is the latest export from our billing system and should map to the CSV you sent.
- Signatory matrix: in our org, VP of Legal (Dana Liu) signs parent-level agreements; Product VP (Michael Santos) signs product-specific order forms. Both prefer DocuSign for speed.
- Security evidence: we have a SOC 2 Type II snapshot hosted on our vendor portal — shared a one-time link below for Redwood Legal access.

Link (vendor portal): https://portal.finlogix.com/soc2/one-time/abcd1234

I’ve copied Dana (legal@finlogix.com) and Procurement — please let us know if you need any additional export fields.

Cheers,
Erin Brooks
Head of Partnerships, FinLogix

Attachments: FinLogix_ExhibitA_20270614.csv (attachment), FinLogix_Signatory_Matrix.pdf (attachment)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: FinLogix intake — next steps for contracts/legal

Kimberly / Marissa —

FinLogix returned Exhibit A and the signatory matrix (see Erin’s email). Quick plan:

- Can Contracts do a 1st-pass redline against our MSA + attached Exhibit A mapping? I started a draft of initial comments in the attached doc (k_iyer_initial_redlines.docx) — primarily around liability cap language and the billing tier definitions in Exhibit A.
- If SOC2 evidence needs verification, please ask Security to confirm the portal snapshot suffices (we usually request the SOC2 cert + controls summary). I included the vendor portal link in the HubSpot notes (related link).
- Signatory mapping looks straightforward — Dana Liu (VP Legal) and Michael Santos (Product VP) will sign via DocuSign. We should prepare separate signature blocks for parent vs product entity in the order form.

Target: return marked-up MSA + order form to FinLogix by end of day Friday (6/18). If Contracts needs more time, propose a rebuttal timeline to Procurement by Thursday.

Thanks — I’m available for a 20 minute sync if that helps.

—Karthik
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: k_iyer_initial_redlines.docx (attachment)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, FinLogix Legal <legal@finlogix.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: Exhibit ownership, signatory mapping, and evidence request

Thanks Karthik / Erin —

I’ll pick this up. Plan:

1) Intake validation — I’ll reconcile the FinLogix Exhibit A CSV to our template fields and flag any unmapped rows (expected: billing code mismatch).
2) Substantive redline — we’ll propose edits on: liability cap (single cap vs per-claim language), data residency wording in Exhibit A, termination for convenience notice period, and an explicit SLA fallback for regional outages. Expect a redline PDF and an annotated Word.
3) Security evidence — I’ll loop Security Ops to validate the SOC2 portal link. If they need the full report, we’ll request the cert and controls summary from legal@finlogix.com.

Deliverable timeline: annotated redline and Concord/DocuSign-ready order form by 6/18 EOD. If anything blocks, I’ll flag with Karthik by 6/17.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference
